tasks.instruction: Review requirements and freeze compatible policy contracts, authorization boundaries, API definitions, and architecture decisions. Do not change application implementation.
Implement the Go API, Google Cloud Identity Platform authentication, tenant-isolated PostgreSQL persistence, approval workflow, adapters, and durable benchmark worker against the reviewed contracts.
Implement and verify the bounded policy evaluator, valid-plan search, mathematical stopping condition, strong comparators, and reproducible held-out benchmark. Never weaken required policy behaviour.

Implement the invitation-only Next.js console against generated API types. All actions use the real Go API. Cover policy approval, evaluations, trace inspection, benchmarks, workspace administration, and audit.
Implement local Compose, reproducible PowerShell commands, CI, Terraform validation, release evidence and rollback. Never apply Terraform or deploy cloud resources.

Independently test requirements, tenant isolation, authentication failure cases, policy equivalence, compulsory work and benchmark honesty. Report findings with exact reproductions; do not change product code.
Review handbacks and independent acceptance evidence. Produce a release candidate report with limitations and approval prerequisites. Do not merge, deploy, or apply infrastructure.
